item.title: Two-alarm house fire on Pine Street displaces family
item.description: Crews responded to 412 Pine Street in Lakewood at 3:15 p.m. for a working fire in a two-story single-family home. The fire went to a second alarm. No injuries were reported; the Red Cross is assisting a family of five.

item.title: Firefighters knock down kitchen fire at Main St. restaurant
item.description: A kitchen fire at a restaurant at 88 Main St., Toms River, was contained to the cooking area. One employee was treated for smoke inhalation.

item.title: Brush fire burns 3 acres near Route 9
item.description: Units from three companies contained a brush fire in the woods off Route 9 in Lakewood.

item.title: Car fire on Garden State Parkway snarls traffic
item.description: A vehicle fire in the southbound lanes near exit 83 closed two lanes for an hour.

item.title: Fire Prevention Week open house Saturday at Station 2
item.description: Meet the firefighters, tour the trucks and learn about smoke alarms.

item.title: Apartment fire at Cedar & Oak avenues; residents evacuated
item.description: Heavy smoke was showing from a three-story apartment building at Cedar Avenue and Oak Avenue in Haverstraw. Several residents were displaced.
